In that execution path, the value of `destDirectory` before line 36 is exactly the same as its value after line 30, establishing a direct dependence. Even though in the true branch `destDirectory` is set to `null` (which does not depend on its previous value), the existence of a path where the value is carried over means the value may depend on it.
